name: Why do garage door frames rot so quickly in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Why do garage door frames rot so quickly in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, winter freeze-thaw cycles and heavy snowpack frequently trap moisture against the base of exterior garage jambs. When snow sits against untreated wood, water wicks into the end grain and freezes, expanding cracks and accelerating wood rot. In neighborhoods across Aurora, Centennial, and Parker, ensuring proper clearance between the bottom of the wood trim and concrete driveway, combined with quality exterior caulking and high-grade primer, is critical to prevent recurring seasonal moisture deterioration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Snow and ice accumulation during winter freeze-thaw cycles trap moisture against the base of wooden jambs, accelerating rot if wood touches bare concrete.
